verdict.rationale: Polar ships an official remote MCP server (mcp.polar.sh) letting AI agents like Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders, and benefits via natural-language-driven agent interfaces, with documented OAuth flow and client setup instructions. A live probe confirms the MCP endpoint is real and auth-gated per spec, corroborating the docs claims beyond just vendor assertion. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of actual natural-language command sessions and concrete example command transcripts.
